experiment_3.verification: Distinct normalized supported properties against check count within assessed relevant code states
experiment_3.curve_gate: Reviewed normalized property IDs and relevant-state evidence; neither new commands nor requirement counts are treated as distinct property coverage

experiment_4.intervention: Suppress a dedicated verification request while continuing the agent; do not terminate the run
experiment_4.resets: New property or relevant content change; unknown state/property/determinism allows work
experiment_4.eligibility: Dedicated checks only; no automatic partial rewriting of compound calls
experiment_4.state_evidence: Complete relevant-content snapshot from runtime, not inferred graph IDs or future labels
experiment_4.calibration: Choose only on development episodes; retain failures and reject threshold if no acceptable setting
experiment_4.margin_status: Proposed absolute success-loss margin; freeze with sample size before held-out execution
experiment_4.held_out_attempts: All 30 attempt-panel tasks in every frozen arm; do not condition on success
experiment_4.required: Expert measurement gate, target model/harness configurations, selected-task environments, recorded actual runtime costs
